Title: Login with valid standard user
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter username | 2. Enter password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to /inventory.html and the Products page is displayed

Title: Login with invalid password
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter valid username | 2. Enter wrong password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error "Username and password do not match any user in this service" is displayed; user stays on login page

Title: Login with invalid username
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter unregistered username | 2. Enter valid password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Same mismatch error message is displayed

Title: Login with empty username and password
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Leave both fields blank | 2. Click Login
Expected Result: Error "Epic sadface: Username is required" is displayed

Title: Login with empty password
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter username | 2. Leave password blank | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error "Epic sadface: Password is required" is displayed

Title: Login with locked out user
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter locked user credentials | 2. Click Login
Expected Result: Error "Sorry, this user has been locked out." is displayed

Title: Password field masks the characters
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Type any text in the Password field
Expected Result: Characters are shown as dots; field type is password

Title: Error message can be dismissed
Precondition: An error message is displayed on login page
Steps: 1. Click the X icon on the error banner
Expected Result: Error banner disappears and red field icons are removed

Title: Login using Enter key
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter valid username and password | 2. Press Enter key
Expected Result: User is logged in without clicking the Login button

Title: Username is case sensitive
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter username in upper case | 2. Enter valid password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails with the mismatch error message

Title: Direct URL access without login
Steps: 1. Open /inventory.html directly in a new browser session
Expected Result: User is redirected to login page with error "You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."

Title: Leading and trailing spaces in username
Precondition: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter username with a space before and after | 2. Enter valid password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails or spaces are trimmed consistently; no application crash

Title: All six products are displayed
Steps: 1. Observe the Products page
Expected Result: 6 products are listed, each with name, description, price, image and Add to cart button

Title: Sort products by Name (A to Z)
Steps: 1. Select "Name (A to Z)" from sort dropdown
Expected Result: Products are listed in ascending alphabetical order

Title: Sort products by Name (Z to A)
Steps: 1. Select "Name (Z to A)" from sort dropdown
Expected Result: Products are listed in descending alphabetical order

Title: Sort products by Price (low to high)
Steps: 1. Select "Price (low to high)"
Expected Result: First product is $7.99 and last product is $49.99

Title: Sort products by Price (high to low)
Steps: 1. Select "Price (high to low)"
Expected Result: First product is $49.99 and last product is $7.99

Title: Open product details by clicking product name
Steps: 1. Click on "Sauce Labs Backpack" title
Expected Result: Product detail page opens with the same name, description and price

Title: Open product details by clicking product image
Steps: 1. Click on the image of any product
Expected Result: Detail page of the same product opens

Title: Back to products from detail page
Precondition: User is on a product detail page
Steps: 1. Click "Back to products"
Expected Result: User returns to the Products page

Title: Each product shows its own correct image
Steps: 1. Compare each product image with its name
Expected Result: Every product has a unique, relevant image; no broken images

Title: Price format is correct
Steps: 1. Check price of every product
Expected Result: Every price is shown as $ followed by a value with two decimals

Title: Add a single product to cart
Steps: 1. Click "Add to cart" on Sauce Labs Backpack
Expected Result: Button changes to "Remove" and cart badge shows 1

Title: Add multiple products to cart
Steps: 1. Click "Add to cart" on three products
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 3

Title: Remove product from Products page
Precondition: One product is already in cart
Steps: 1. Click "Remove" on that product
Expected Result: Button changes back to "Add to cart" and badge is removed

Title: Remove product from Cart page
Steps: 1. Open cart | 2. Click "Remove" on one product
Expected Result: Product is removed from the list and badge shows 1

Title: Cart page shows correct product details
Steps: 1. Click the cart icon
Expected Result: Cart shows QTY 1, correct name, description and price

Title: Continue Shopping from cart
Steps: 1. Click "Continue Shopping"
Expected Result: User returns to Products page and cart items are retained

Title: Cart is retained after page refresh
Steps: 1. Refresh the browser page
Expected Result: Cart badge still shows 2 and products remain in cart

Title: Add to cart from product detail page
Precondition: User is on a product detail page
Steps: 1. Click "Add to cart"
Expected Result: Badge count increases by 1 and button changes to "Remove"

Title: Cart is retained after logout and login
Steps: 1. Logout | 2. Login again with the same user
Expected Result: Cart content is retained (as per current application behaviour)

Title: Cart badge is hidden when cart is empty
Steps: 1. Observe the cart icon
Expected Result: No badge number is displayed on the cart icon

Title: Checkout with empty Postal Code

Title: Cancel on information page
Precondition: User is on Checkout: Your Information
Steps: 1. Click Cancel
Expected Result: User returns to the Cart page; items are retained

Title: Finish the order
Steps: 1. Click Finish
Expected Result: "Thank you for your order!" message is displayed on Checkout: Complete page

Title: Back Home after order completion
Steps: 1. Click "Back Home"

Title: Cancel on overview page
Steps: 1. Click Cancel
Expected Result: User returns to Products page; order is not placed

Title: Payment and shipping information are displayed
Steps: 1. Observe Payment Information and Shipping Information
Expected Result: Payment card reference and shipping method text are displayed

Title: Checkout with empty cart
Steps: 1. Open cart | 2. Click Checkout
Expected Result: User should not be allowed to proceed to checkout with an empty cart

Steps: 1. Click the burger menu icon
